credits._noteLowestRate: Schedule 1: federal non-refundable credits use the statutory lowest rate for 2026 (14% first bracket).

basicPersonalAmount._note: 2026 CRA indexation table. Maximum BPA when net income ≤ start of 29% bracket; minimum when net income ≥ start of 33% bracket; linear phase-out between. Credit = amount × lowestRateForCredits.

cppEiCredit._note: CPP/EI non-refundable credit rate matches statutory lowest federal rate for 2026.

ageAmount._note: CRA indexation table 2026: Age amount $9,208; net income threshold $46,432. Phase-out 15% (ITA 118(2)).

pensionIncomeAmount._note: Federal pension income amount remains $2,000 for 2026 (Finance Canada credit table; not CPI-indexed).

oasRecovery._source: CRA indexation table: Old age security repayment threshold 2026. canada.ca/en/services/benefits/publicpensions/old-age-security/recovery-tax.html
oasRecovery._note: Repay 15% of line 23400 above the threshold, not exceeding OAS received.

_note: 2026 federal brackets and indexed amounts. RRSP 2026 dollar maximum $33,810 (earned income room is 18% of prior year to this cap).
